## File: README.md

<div align="center">

# catalog-kit

**Every MGPL Diagnostics test, in one typed package.**
Tests and profiles with their parameters, units, methods, reference ranges, sample types and prices,
plus fast fuzzy search. Zero dependencies. Works in Node, browsers, workers and edge runtimes.

![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-614-14264A) ![parameters](https://img.shields.io/badge/parameters-1911-14264A) ![search](https://img.shields.io/badge/search-~30%C2%B5s-C2410C) ![deps](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-E9A23B)

</div>

## What's inside

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **614 entries** (584 tests, 30 profiles) across 9 departments | Clinical Biochemistry, Clinical Pathology, Cytopathology, Hematology, Histopathology, Immunology, Microbiology, Molecular, Serology |
| **1,911 parameters** | unit, method, male / female reference interval, options, narrative reference |
| **29 sample types** | SERUM, EDTA, URINE, SODIUM FLUORIDE, SODIUM CITRATE, STOOL, SEMEN, CSF… |
| **83 calculated parameters** | each with its formula, in readable form (`(28.7*HBA1C)-46.7`) |
| **Prices** | in rupees, for 612 tests |

Every entry has an **MGPL id**: `MGPLT0001`… for tests, `MGPLP0001`… for profiles and `MGPLK0001`…
for packages (none yet). Each kind has its own gap-free sequence, and the catalog lists tests first,
then profiles, then packages. The lab software's old numeric id is kept as `legacyId`.

Units and methods are normalised (`mg/dl` → `mg/dL`, `CALCULATED` → `Calculated`), and narrative
references are plain text, with no HTML.

## Install

```bash
npm install @mgpl-diagnostics/catalog-kit
```

Published on GitHub Packages. Add `@mgpl-diagnostics:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com` to `.npmrc`.

## Use

```ts
import { search, getTestByCode, formatRange, flagResult, totalPrice } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/catalog-kit";

search("lft")[0].test.name;            // "LIVER FUNCTION TESTS"
search("vit d").map((h) => h.test.name); // ["VITAMIN D PROFILE (D2,D3,TOTAL D)", "Vitamin D3", …]
search("thyriod");                     // typo-tolerant → Thyroid tests

const cbc = getTestByCode("CBC")!;      // also short / search codes, case-insensitive
cbc.id;                                 // "MGPLT0196"
getTest("MGPLT0196") === cbc;           // by MGPL id (or by the old numeric id, cbc.legacyId)
cbc.sampleType;                         // "EDTA"
cbc.mrp;                                // price in rupees

const hb = cbc.parameters.find((p) => p.name === "Hemoglobin")!;
hb.unit;                                // "g/dL"
hb.method;                              // "SLS-Hemoglobin"
formatRange(hb, "female");              // "11 - 16"
flagResult(hb, 10.2, "female");         // "L"

totalPrice(["CBC", "HBA1C", "MGPLP0014"]); // { total, tests, unknown: [] }
```

## Search

`search(query, { limit, department, sampleType, fuzzy })` ranks tests by:

1. **Exact code or id**: `CBC`, `LIFT`, `HBA1C`, `T3T4TSH`, `MGPLP0014`.
2. **Exact words** in the name, then parameters, department and sample type.
3. **Prefixes**: `creatinin` → Creatinine.
4. **Typos**: `cholestrol`, `thyriod` (trigram similarity).
5. **Lab shorthand**: `lft`, `kft`, `rft`, `sgpt`, `fbs`, `ppbs`, `vit d`, `b12`, `hemogram`… (see `SYNONYMS`).

British and American spellings fold together (`haemoglobin` = `hemoglobin`), and joined forms match
split names (`b12` finds "VITAMIN B-12").

The index builds in about 20–30 ms on first use. Each query then takes about 30 µs. `npm test`
measures both.

## API

| Export | |
| --- | --- |
| `TESTS`, `CATALOG` | the data |
| `DEPARTMENTS`, `SAMPLE_TYPES` | sorted lists |
| `getTest(id)`, `getTestByCode(code)` | lookups (MGPL id, or the old numeric `legacyId`) |
| `testsByKind(k)`, `testsByDepartment(d)`, `testsBySampleType(s)` | filters |
| `isProfile(test)`, `isPackage(test)` | `kind` is `profile` (LFT, Kidney Profile, TORCH…) or `package` |
| `ID_PREFIX`, `ID_PATTERN` | `MGPLT` / `MGPLP` / `MGPLK`, and `/^MGPL[TPK]\d{4}$/` |
| `search(q, opts)`, `createSearchIndex(tests)` | search, or build your own index over a subset |
| `rangeFor(param, sex)`, `formatRange(param, sex)`, `flagResult(param, value, sex)` | reference intervals |
| `totalPrice(idsOrCodes)` | sum prices, reporting unknown entries |
| `normalize(text)`, `SYNONYMS` | the search's text folding and shorthand table |

Types: `LabTest`, `CatalogId`, `CatalogKind` (`test` · `profile` · `package`), `Parameter`, `ParameterType` (`numeric` · `text` · `options` · `image` · `title`),
`Interval`, `Bound`, `Department`, `Sex`.

## Data

`data/catalog.json` is the source of truth. `npm run data` turns it into `src/data.generated.ts`,
which holds the JSON as a string parsed at load time. That is faster than a large object literal,
and cheap for TypeScript to check. Builds and tests regenerate it automatically.

To add an entry, give it a `kind` and `"id": null` in the JSON and run `npm run ids`: it assigns the
next id of that kind and re-orders the catalog (tests, profiles, packages). Ids are never renumbered
or reused, so references stay valid; `npm test` checks the sequences.

> **Medical note.** Reference ranges come from the lab's configured test master. They must be
> checked by a qualified pathologist before clinical use.

## The family

| Repo | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [report-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit) | A4 report PDF + HTML |
| [invoice-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit) | patient invoices |
| **catalog-kit** | tests, ranges, prices, search |
| [client](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/client) | headless browser SDK |
| [report-studio](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/report-studio) | reference Next.js app |

## File: AGENTS.md

# AGENTS.md — @mgpl-diagnostics/catalog-kit

The test catalog for MGPL Diagnostics: every test with parameters, units, methods, reference
ranges, sample types and prices, plus search. A pure data + functions package: no dependencies,
no I/O, no UI. report-kit and invoice-kit consume it.

## Map

```
data/catalog.json        THE DATA — source of truth (edit here)
scripts/gen-data.mjs     data/catalog.json → src/data.generated.ts (git-ignored, generated on build/test)
scripts/ids.mjs          npm run ids: assigns MGPL ids to new entries, orders tests → profiles → packages
src/types.ts             LabTest, Parameter, Interval, ParameterType…
src/search.ts            inverted index + binary-search prefixes + trigram typo fallback + SYNONYMS
src/index.ts             TESTS, lookups, filters, rangeFor / formatRange / flagResult, totalPrice
scripts/test.ts          integrity, lookups, search-quality table, speed benchmark
```

## Rules

1. **Edit data in `data/catalog.json` only.** Never hand-edit `src/data.generated.ts`.
2. **Prices** are whole rupees in `mrp`; they all end in 9 (`npm test` checks it). Change prices in the JSON.
3. **Units and methods are canonical** (`mg/dL`, `g/dL`, `IU/mL`, `µmol/L`; `Calculated`, `CLIA`). Keep new
   entries in the same forms.
4. **No HTML** in `referenceText` (plain text, newlines for rows). `npm test` checks tags and entities.
5. **Calculated parameters** keep `formula` (lab-software form, `pr_<id>`) and `formulaText` (names).
6. **Search quality is tested.** When you add a shorthand to `SYNONYMS`, add a row to the `expect`
   table in `scripts/test.ts`. Synonym values are `|`-separated phrases whose words must all match.
7. **Don't invent reference ranges.** They come from the lab's test master and need a pathologist's sign-off.
8. Never commit patient data, credentials, or cost prices.
9. **Ids are MGPL ids and never change.** `MGPLT####` tests, `MGPLP####` profiles, `MGPLK####` packages, one
   gap-free sequence per kind, catalog ordered tests → profiles → packages. Add an entry with its `kind` and
   `"id": null`, then `npm run ids`. Never renumber or reuse an id; `legacyId` keeps the lab software's old id.

## Commands

```bash
npm test          # regenerates data, runs all checks + benchmark
npm run typecheck
npm run build     # dist/index.js (data inlined) + index.d.ts
```

## File: llms.txt

# @mgpl-diagnostics/catalog-kit

> Typed, zero-dependency catalog of MGPL Diagnostics lab tests: 614 tests and profiles (MGPL ids: MGPLT0001… tests, MGPLP0001… profiles, MGPLK0001… packages), 1,911 parameters with canonical units, methods, male/female reference intervals, options, narrative references and readable formulas for calculated values; sample types; prices in rupees. Includes a fast fuzzy search (~30 µs/query) that understands lab shorthand (LFT, KFT, SGPT, FBS, Vit D, B12) and typos.

Key facts for agents:
- `search(query, { limit, department, sampleType, fuzzy })` → `[{ test, score }]`.
- `getTestByCode("CBC")`, `getTest("MGPLT0196")` (or the old numeric `legacyId`), `testsByKind()`, `testsByDepartment()`, `testsBySampleType()`, `isProfile()`, `isPackage()`.
- Ids: `test.id` is `MGPL` + kind letter (T/P/K) + 4 digits, one gap-free sequence per kind; tests come first, then profiles, then packages. New entries get ids from `npm run ids`; ids are never renumbered.
- `formatRange(param, sex)`, `flagResult(param, value, sex)` → "L" | "H" | "".
- `totalPrice(["CBC", "HBA1C"])` → { total, tests, unknown }. Prices are `test.mrp`, whole rupees.
- Data lives in `data/catalog.json`; `src/data.generated.ts` is generated. Edit the JSON, then `npm test`.
- Reference ranges need a pathologist's sign-off before clinical use.

## File: scripts/gen-data.mjs

```js
// data/catalog.json → src/data.generated.ts
// The JSON is embedded as a string and parsed at load time: JSON.parse is faster than evaluating a
// large object literal, and TypeScript only has to check one string instead of 600 objects.
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const root = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const json = readFileSync(join(root, "data", "catalog.json"), "utf8");
const data = JSON.parse(json); // validates
const src = `// GENERATED by scripts/gen-data.mjs from data/catalog.json. Do not edit.
import type { Catalog } from "./types";

export const CATALOG: Catalog = JSON.parse(${JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify(data))});
`;
writeFileSync(join(root, "src", "data.generated.ts"), src);
console.log(`src/data.generated.ts  ${data.tests.length} tests, ${(src.length / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB`);
```

## File: scripts/ids.mjs

```js
// npm run ids — gives every catalog entry without an id the next MGPL id of its kind, then orders the
// catalog tests → profiles → packages (by id within each kind). Existing ids never change.
//   MGPLT0001… tests, MGPLP0001… profiles, MGPLK0001… packages
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const ID_PREFIX = { test: "MGPLT", profile: "MGPLP", package: "MGPLK" };
const KINDS = Object.keys(ID_PREFIX);
const ID = /^MGPL([TPK])(\d{4})$/;

const file = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..", "data", "catalog.json");
const data = JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, "utf8"));

const next = Object.fromEntries(KINDS.map((k) => [k, 0]));
for (const t of data.tests) {
  if (!KINDS.includes(t.kind)) throw new Error(`${t.name}: kind must be one of ${KINDS.join(", ")}`);
  if (t.id == null) continue;
  const m = ID.exec(t.id);
  if (!m || !t.id.startsWith(ID_PREFIX[t.kind])) throw new Error(`${t.name}: id ${t.id} does not match kind ${t.kind}`);
  next[t.kind] = Math.max(next[t.kind], Number(m[2]));
}
let added = 0;
data.tests = data.tests.map((t) => {
  if (t.id != null) return t;
  added++;
  const id = `${ID_PREFIX[t.kind]}${String(++next[t.kind]).padStart(4, "0")}`;
  const { id: _, kind, legacyId = null, ...rest } = t;
  return { id, kind, legacyId, ...rest };
});
data.tests.sort((a, b) => KINDS.indexOf(a.kind) - KINDS.indexOf(b.kind) || (a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0));
writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(data, null, 1) + "\n");
const counts = KINDS.map((k) => `${data.tests.filter((t) => t.kind === k).length} ${k}s`).join(", ");
console.log(`data/catalog.json  ${added} new ids; ${counts}`);
```

## File: scripts/llms-full.mjs

````js
// Builds llms-full.txt: every doc and source file of the repo in one plain-text document for AI tools.
//   node scripts/llms-full.mjs "<title>" <file-or-folder> [file-or-folder …]
// Folders are walked recursively. Output order: README, AGENTS, docs, then the rest alphabetically.
// Skipped: build output, dependencies, lockfiles, generated files, binaries. Files over 150 KB are
// listed (path + size) instead of inlined. CI checks the file is up to date (`npm run llms` + git diff).
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { extname, join, relative } from "node:path";

const [title, ...inputs] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!title || !inputs.length) {
  console.error('usage: node scripts/llms-full.mjs "<title>" <file-or-folder> …');
  process.exit(1);
}

const TEXT = new Set([".ts", ".tsx", ".mts", ".cts", ".js", ".mjs", ".cjs", ".md", ".mdx", ".json", ".css", ".yml", ".yaml", ".txt", ".graphql", ".gql", ".sql", ".html"]);
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(["node_modules", "dist", ".next", ".git", ".turbo", "coverage", "examples", ".pg-test"]);
const SKIP_FILES = /(^|\/)(package-lock\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml|yarn\.lock|llms-full\.txt|[^/]*\.generated\.[^/]+|[^/]*\.log)$/;
const MAX = 150 * 1024;
const LANG = { ".ts": "ts", ".tsx": "tsx", ".mts": "ts", ".cts": "ts", ".js": "js", ".mjs": "js", ".cjs": "js", ".json": "json", ".css": "css", ".yml": "yaml", ".yaml": "yaml", ".graphql": "graphql", ".gql": "graphql", ".sql": "sql", ".html": "html" };

const posix = (p) => p.split("\\").join("/");
const files = new Set();
function walk(p) {
  const st = statSync(p);
  if (st.isDirectory()) {
    for (const name of readdirSync(p)) if (!SKIP_DIRS.has(name)) walk(join(p, name));
  } else if (TEXT.has(extname(p).toLowerCase()) && !SKIP_FILES.test(posix(p))) {
    files.add(posix(relative(".", p)));
  }
}
for (const input of inputs) walk(input);

const rank = (f) => (/^README\.md$/i.test(f) ? 0 : /^AGENTS\.md$/i.test(f) ? 1 : /^docs\//.test(f) ? 2 : 3);
const ordered = [...files].sort((a, b) => rank(a) - rank(b) || (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));

const parts = [`# ${title} — full documentation and source\n\n> Generated by scripts/llms-full.mjs. Do not edit by hand. ${ordered.length} files.\n\n## Contents\n\n${ordered.map((f) => `- ${f}`).join("\n")}\n`];
const omitted = [];
for (const f of ordered) {
  // LF-normalised text, so Windows and Linux checkouts produce byte-identical output
  const body = readFileSync(f, "utf8").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").trim();
  const size = Buffer.byteLength(body);
  if (size > MAX) {
    omitted.push(`${f} (${(size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB)`);
    parts.push(`\n\n---\n\n## File: ${f}\n\n_Omitted: ${(size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB. Read the file directly._\n`);
    continue;
  }
  const lang = LANG[extname(f).toLowerCase()];
  const fence = body.includes("```") ? "````" : "```";
  parts.push(`\n\n---\n\n## File: ${f}\n\n${lang ? `${fence}${lang}\n${body}\n${fence}` : body}\n`);
}
const out = parts.join("");
writeFileSync("llms-full.txt", out);
console.log(`llms-full.txt: ${ordered.length} files, ${(out.length / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB${omitted.length ? `; omitted (too large): ${omitted.join(", ")}` : ""}`);
````

## File: scripts/test.ts

```ts
// npm test — data integrity, lookups, ranges, search quality and search speed.
import {
  DEPARTMENTS, ID_PATTERN, ID_PREFIX, SAMPLE_TYPES, TESTS, createSearchIndex, flagResult, formatRange, getTest,
  getTestByCode, isPackage, isProfile, rangeFor, search, testsByKind, totalPrice, type CatalogKind,
} from "../src/index";

let failed = 0;
const ok = (cond: unknown, msg: string) => {
  if (cond) console.log(`ok    ${msg}`);
  else { failed++; console.log(`FAIL  ${msg}`); }
};

// ---- data
ok(TESTS.length >= 600, `${TESTS.length} tests`);
ok(new Set(TESTS.map((t) => t.id)).size === TESTS.length, "ids are unique");

// ---- MGPL ids: per-kind sequences, tests first, then profiles, then packages
const KINDS: CatalogKind[] = ["test", "profile", "package"];
ok(TESTS.every((t) => KINDS.includes(t.kind)), "every entry has a kind (test, profile or package)");
ok(TESTS.every((t) => ID_PATTERN.test(t.id) && t.id.startsWith(ID_PREFIX[t.kind])), "every id is MGPL + kind letter + 4 digits");
const ranks = TESTS.map((t) => KINDS.indexOf(t.kind));
ok(ranks.every((r, i) => i === 0 || ranks[i - 1]! <= r), "catalog order: tests, then profiles, then packages");
for (const kind of KINDS) {
  const ids = testsByKind(kind).map((t) => t.id);
  const seq = ids.every((id, i) => id === `${ID_PREFIX[kind]}${String(i + 1).padStart(4, "0")}`);
  ok(seq, `${kind} ids run ${ids[0] ?? "-"}…${ids[ids.length - 1] ?? "-"} with no gaps (${ids.length})`);
}
const legacy = TESTS.map((t) => t.legacyId).filter((n): n is number => n != null);
ok(new Set(legacy).size === legacy.length, `legacy ids are unique (${legacy.length})`);
const allCodes = TESTS.flatMap((t) => [t.code, t.shortCode, t.searchCode]).filter((c): c is string => !!c);
ok(allCodes.every((c) => !/^MGPL/i.test(c)), "no test code looks like an MGPL id");
ok(testsByKind("profile").length >= 25, `${testsByKind("profile").length} profiles`);
ok(TESTS.every((t) => t.name && t.department), "every test has a name and department");
ok(TESTS.every((t) => t.sampleType), "every test has a sample type");
const params = TESTS.flatMap((t) => t.parameters);
ok(params.length > 1800, `${params.length} parameters`);
ok(params.every((p) => !/<[a-z][^>]*>/i.test(p.referenceText ?? "")), "no HTML left in reference text");
ok(params.every((p) => !/&[a-z]+;/i.test(p.referenceText ?? "")), "no HTML entities left in reference text");
ok(params.every((p) => !p.unit || p.unit === p.unit.trim()), "units are trimmed");
ok(params.filter((p) => p.formula).every((p) => p.formulaText), "every formula has a readable formulaText");
const priced = TESTS.filter((t) => (t.mrp ?? 0) > 0);
ok(priced.length >= 600, `${priced.length} tests priced`);
ok(priced.every((t) => t.mrp! % 10 === 9), "prices end in 9");
ok(DEPARTMENTS.length === 9, `departments: ${DEPARTMENTS.join(", ")}`);
ok(SAMPLE_TYPES.includes("SERUM") && SAMPLE_TYPES.includes("EDTA") && SAMPLE_TYPES.includes("URINE"), `${SAMPLE_TYPES.length} sample types`);

// ---- lookups
const cbc = getTestByCode("cbc");
ok(cbc?.name === "Complete Blood Count (CBC)", `getTestByCode("cbc") → ${cbc?.name}`);
ok(cbc && getTest(cbc.id) === cbc, `getTest("${cbc?.id}")`);
ok(cbc && getTest(cbc.id.toLowerCase()) === cbc, "getTest(id) is case-insensitive");
ok(cbc && cbc.legacyId != null && getTest(cbc.legacyId) === cbc, `getTest(${cbc?.legacyId}) finds the legacy id`);
ok(cbc && !isProfile(cbc) && cbc.id.startsWith("MGPLT"), "CBC is a test");
const lipid = getTestByCode("LIPR");
ok(lipid && isProfile(lipid) && !isPackage(lipid) && lipid.id.startsWith("MGPLP"), `Lipid Profile is a profile (${lipid?.id})`);
ok(getTest("MGPLT9999") === undefined && getTest(1) === undefined, "unknown ids → undefined");
const hb = cbc?.parameters.find((p) => p.name === "Hemoglobin");
ok(hb?.unit === "g/dL", `Hemoglobin unit ${hb?.unit}`);
ok(hb && formatRange(hb, "male") === "13 - 17" && formatRange(hb, "female") === "11 - 16", `Hb range M ${hb && formatRange(hb, "male")} / F ${hb && formatRange(hb, "female")}`);
ok(hb && flagResult(hb, 10.2, "female") === "L" && flagResult(hb, 18, "male") === "H" && flagResult(hb, 14, "male") === "", "flagResult L / H / normal");
const t = totalPrice(["CBC", "HBA1C", "nope"]);
ok(t.tests.length === 2 && t.unknown[0] === "nope" && t.total === t.tests[0]!.mrp! + t.tests[1]!.mrp!, `totalPrice → Rs. ${t.total}, unknown ${t.unknown}`);

const byIds = totalPrice(["MGPLT0001", "mgplp0001", TESTS[1]!.legacyId!]);
ok(byIds.unknown.length === 0 && byIds.tests[0] === TESTS[0] && byIds.tests[1] === testsByKind("profile")[0] && byIds.tests[2] === TESTS[1],
  "totalPrice takes MGPL ids, lower case and legacy ids");

// ---- every entry in data/catalog.json works through the public API
const broken: string[] = [];
for (const e of TESTS) {
  const why: string[] = [];
  if (getTest(e.id) !== e) why.push("getTest(id)");
  if (e.legacyId != null && getTest(e.legacyId) !== e) why.push("getTest(legacyId)");
  const hit = e.code ? getTestByCode(e.code) : undefined;
  if (e.code && ![hit?.code, hit?.shortCode, hit?.searchCode].some((c) => c?.toUpperCase() === e.code!.toUpperCase())) why.push("getTestByCode(code)");
  if (!search(e.id, { limit: 1 }).some((h) => h.test === e)) why.push("search(id)");
  if (!search(e.name, { limit: 10 }).some((h) => h.test.name.toLowerCase() === e.name.toLowerCase())) why.push("search(name)");
  const one = totalPrice([e.id]);
  if (one.tests[0] !== e || one.total !== (e.mrp ?? 0)) why.push("totalPrice([id])");
  if (e.parameterCount !== e.parameters.length) why.push(`parameterCount ${e.parameterCount} ≠ ${e.parameters.length}`);
  for (const p of e.parameters) {
    if (typeof formatRange(p, "male") !== "string" || typeof formatRange(p, "female") !== "string") why.push(`formatRange(${p.name})`);
    const r = rangeFor(p, "male");
    if (p.type === "numeric" && r && typeof r.low === "number" && flagResult(p, r.low - 1, "male") !== "L") why.push(`flagResult(${p.name})`);
  }
  if (why.length) broken.push(`${e.id} ${e.name}: ${why.join(", ")}`);
}
// A code shared by two entries resolves to the first one; list them so the data can be cleaned up.
const shared = TESTS.filter((e) => e.code && getTestByCode(e.code) !== e).map((e) => `${e.code} (${e.id} ${e.name} → ${getTestByCode(e.code!)!.id})`);
if (shared.length) console.log(`note  codes shared by two entries: ${shared.join("; ")}`);
ok(broken.length === 0, `all ${TESTS.length} entries work by id, legacy id, code, search, price and ranges`);
for (const b of broken.slice(0, 20)) console.log(`      ${b}`);

// ---- search quality: the query → a test whose name matches, in the top 3
const expect: [string, RegExp][] = [
  ["lft", /liver function/i],
  ["kft", /kidney profile/i],
  ["rft", /kidney profile/i],
  ["cbc", /complete blood count/i],
  ["hemogram", /complete blood count/i],
  ["thyroid", /thyroid profile/i],
  ["tsh", /tsh/i],
  ["hba1c", /hba1c/i],
  ["sugar fasting", /glucose f/i],
  ["fbs", /glucose f/i],
  ["ppbs", /glucose pp/i],
  ["vit d", /vitamin d/i],
  ["vitamin b12", /b12/i],
  ["lipid", /lipid profile/i],
  ["haemoglobin", /h(a)?emoglobin|hb/i],
  ["urine routine", /urine/i],
  ["blood group", /blood group/i],
  ["widal", /widal/i],
  ["dengue", /dengue/i],
  ["thyriod", /thyroid/i], // typo
  ["cholestrol", /cholesterol|lipid/i], // typo
  ["creatinin", /creatinine/i], // prefix
];
for (const [q, re] of expect) {
  const top = search(q, { limit: 3 }).map((h) => h.test.name);
  ok(top.some((n) => re.test(n)), `search("${q}") → ${top.join(" | ") || "(nothing)"}`);
}
ok(search("serum", { sampleType: "URINE" }).every((h) => h.test.sampleType === "URINE"), "sampleType filter");
ok(search("", {}).length === 0, "empty query → no results");

// ---- speed
const t0 = performance.now();
const idx = createSearchIndex(TESTS);
const build = performance.now() - t0;
const queries = expect.map(([q]) => q);
const N = 20_000;
const t1 = performance.now();
for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) idx.search(queries[i % queries.length]!, { limit: 10 });
const per = ((performance.now() - t1) / N) * 1000;
console.log(`\nindex build ${build.toFixed(1)} ms · ${per.toFixed(1)} µs per query (${N} queries)`);
ok(per < 1000, "search under 1 ms per query");

console.log(failed ? `\n${failed} FAILED` : "\nAll checks passed.");
process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);
```

## File: src/index.ts

```ts
import { CATALOG } from "./data.generated";
import { createSearchIndex, type SearchHit, type SearchIndex, type SearchOptions } from "./search";
import type { CatalogKind, Interval, LabTest, Parameter, Sex } from "./types";

export * from "./types";
export { createSearchIndex, normalize, SYNONYMS } from "./search";
export type { SearchHit, SearchIndex, SearchOptions } from "./search";
export { CATALOG };

/** Every entry in catalog order: tests, then profiles, then packages, each by id. */
export const TESTS: readonly LabTest[] = CATALOG.tests;

/** MGPL id prefix of each kind: MGPLT0001 (test), MGPLP0001 (profile), MGPLK0001 (package). */
export const ID_PREFIX: Readonly<Record<CatalogKind, string>> = { test: "MGPLT", profile: "MGPLP", package: "MGPLK" };
/** Matches an MGPL catalog id. */
export const ID_PATTERN = /^MGPL[TPK]\d{4}$/;

const byId = new Map<string, LabTest>(TESTS.map((t) => [t.id, t]));
const byLegacyId = new Map<number, LabTest>();
for (const t of TESTS) if (t.legacyId != null) byLegacyId.set(t.legacyId, t);
const byCode = new Map<string, LabTest>();
for (const t of TESTS)
  for (const c of [t.code, t.shortCode, t.searchCode]) if (c && !byCode.has(c.toUpperCase())) byCode.set(c.toUpperCase(), t);

/** Sorted list of departments. */
export const DEPARTMENTS: readonly string[] = [...new Set(TESTS.map((t) => t.department))].sort();
/** Sorted list of primary sample types. */
export const SAMPLE_TYPES: readonly string[] = [...new Set(TESTS.map((t) => t.sampleType).filter((s): s is string => !!s))].sort();

/** By MGPL id ("MGPLT0001", case-insensitive), or by the lab software's numeric id (`legacyId`). */
export function getTest(id: string | number): LabTest | undefined {
  return typeof id === "number" ? byLegacyId.get(id) : byId.get(id.trim().toUpperCase());
}

/** Entries of one kind, in id order. */
export function testsByKind(kind: CatalogKind): LabTest[] {
  return TESTS.filter((t) => t.kind === kind);
}

/** By test code, short code or search code (case-insensitive), e.g. "CBC", "LIFT", "HBA1C". */
export function getTestByCode(code: string): LabTest | undefined {
  return byCode.get(code.trim().toUpperCase());
}

export function testsByDepartment(department: string): LabTest[] {
  return TESTS.filter((t) => t.department === department);
}

export function testsBySampleType(sampleType: string): LabTest[] {
  return TESTS.filter((t) => t.sampleType === sampleType);
}

/** Profiles bundle tests the lab also sells on their own (LFT, Kidney Profile, Thyroid Profile, TORCH…). */
export function isProfile(test: LabTest): boolean {
  return test.kind === "profile";
}

/** Packages bundle tests and profiles (health check-ups). */
export function isPackage(test: LabTest): boolean {
  return test.kind === "package";
}

let index: SearchIndex | undefined;
/** Fuzzy search over names, codes, parameters, departments and sample types. */
export function search(query: string, options?: SearchOptions): SearchHit[] {
  index ??= createSearchIndex(TESTS);
  return index.search(query, options);
}

/** Reference interval for a sex (falls back to the other sex when only one is set). */
export function rangeFor(param: Parameter, sex?: Sex): Interval | null {
  if (sex === "female") return param.female ?? param.male;
  return param.male ?? param.female;
}

/** "13 - 17", "< 5", "> 40", or the narrative reference when there is no interval. */
export function formatRange(param: Parameter, sex?: Sex): string {
  const r = rangeFor(param, sex);
  if (r) {
    const { low, high } = r;
    if (low != null && high != null && low !== "" && high !== "") return `${low} - ${high}`;
    if (high != null && high !== "") return `< ${high}`;
    if (low != null && low !== "") return `> ${low}`;
  }
  if (param.options?.length) return param.options.join(" / ");
  return param.referenceText ?? "";
}

/** Flag a numeric result: "L" below, "H" above, "" inside or not comparable. */
export function flagResult(param: Parameter, value: number, sex?: Sex): "L" | "H" | "" {
  const r = rangeFor(param, sex);
  if (!r) return "";
  const low = typeof r.low === "number" ? r.low : Number.NaN;
  const high = typeof r.high === "number" ? r.high : Number.NaN;
  if (!Number.isNaN(low) && value < low) return "L";
  if (!Number.isNaN(high) && value > high) return "H";
  return "";
}

/** Total price for MGPL ids, codes or legacy numeric ids. Unknown entries are reported, not ignored. */
export function totalPrice(items: (number | string)[]): { total: number; tests: LabTest[]; unknown: (number | string)[] } {
  const tests: LabTest[] = [];
  const unknown: (number | string)[] = [];
  for (const it of items) {
    const t = typeof it === "number" ? getTest(it) : (getTest(it) ?? getTestByCode(it));
    if (t) tests.push(t);
    else unknown.push(it);
  }
  return { total: tests.reduce((s, t) => s + (t.mrp ?? 0), 0), tests, unknown };
}
```

## File: src/search.ts

```ts
import type { LabTest } from "./types";

/**
 * In-memory search over tests. Built once (≈ 20 ms), then each query costs
 * O(query words × log vocabulary) plus postings:
 *   1. exact word / code hits       (inverted index, Map)
 *   2. prefix hits                  (sorted vocabulary + binary search)
 *   3. typo-tolerant fallback       (trigram index, Dice similarity)
 * Lab shorthand (LFT, KFT, SGPT, FBS, Vit D…) is expanded through SYNONYMS.
 */

export interface SearchOptions {
  /** Max results. Default 20. */
  limit?: number;
  /** Only tests from this department. */
  department?: string;
  /** Only tests with this sample type. */
  sampleType?: string;
  /** Allow typo matches. Default true. */
  fuzzy?: boolean;
}

export interface SearchHit {
  test: LabTest;
  score: number;
}

/**
 * Shorthand → alternatives separated by "|". Each alternative is a phrase whose words must all
 * match (so "b12" → "vitamin b12" does not match Vitamin C on the word "vitamin" alone).
 * Keys may be single words or whole queries ("vit d").
 */
export const SYNONYMS: Record<string, string> = {
  lft: "liver function",
  kft: "kidney profile|renal",
  rft: "kidney profile|renal",
  renal: "kidney",
  cbc: "complete blood count",
  hemogram: "complete blood count",
  tft: "thyroid profile",
  sgpt: "alt|alanine",
  sgot: "ast|aspartate",
  fbs: "glucose f|fasting glucose|sugar fasting",
  bsf: "glucose f|fasting glucose|sugar fasting",
  ppbs: "glucose pp|post prandial",
  bspp: "glucose pp|post prandial",
  rbs: "glucose r|random glucose|sugar random",
  sugar: "glucose",
  vitd: "vitamin d",
  "vit d": "vitamin d",
  vitb12: "vitamin b12|cobalamine",
  b12: "vitamin b12|cobalamine",
  "vit b12": "vitamin b12|cobalamine",
  crp: "c reactive protein|crp",
  hb: "hemoglobin",
  urm: "urine routine",
  "urine r m": "urine routine",
  lipid: "lipid profile",
  a1c: "hba1c",
  psa: "prostate specific antigen|psa",
  hcg: "beta hcg|hcg",
  upt: "pregnancy",
};

const FOLDS: [RegExp, string][] = [
  [/ae/g, "e"], // haemoglobin → hemoglobin
  [/oe/g, "e"], // oestradiol → estradiol
  [/leuc/g, "leuk"],
  [/sulph/g, "sulf"],
];

/** lower-case, strip accents, fold British/American spellings, keep letters/digits. */
export function normalize(s: string): string {
  let t = s.normalize("NFKD").replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, "").toLowerCase();
  for (const [re, to] of FOLDS) t = t.replace(re, to);
  return t.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ").trim();
}

const words = (s: string) => normalize(s).split(" ").filter(Boolean);
const synonymAlternatives = (key: string): string[][] =>
  (SYNONYMS[key] ?? "").split("|").map(words).filter((a) => a.length);

function trigrams(word: string): string[] {
  const w = `  ${word} `;
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < w.length - 2; i++) out.push(w.slice(i, i + 3));
  return out;
}

const W = { code: 10, name: 4, param: 1.5, dept: 1, sample: 1 } as const;

interface Posting {
  doc: number;
  weight: number;
}

export interface SearchIndex {
  search(query: string, options?: SearchOptions): SearchHit[];
  readonly size: number;
}

export function createSearchIndex(tests: readonly LabTest[]): SearchIndex {
  const postings = new Map<string, Posting[]>();
  const codes = new Map<string, number[]>();
  const names = tests.map((t) => normalize(t.name));
  const compactNames = names.map((n) => n.replace(/ /g, ""));

  const add = (token: string, doc: number, weight: number) => {
    let list = postings.get(token);
    if (!list) postings.set(token, (list = []));
    const last = list[list.length - 1];
    if (last && last.doc === doc) last.weight = Math.max(last.weight, weight);
    else list.push({ doc, weight });
  };

  tests.forEach((t, doc) => {
    for (const c of [t.id, t.code, t.shortCode, t.searchCode]) {
      if (!c) continue;
      const k = normalize(c).replace(/ /g, "");
      if (!k) continue;
      const list = codes.get(k) ?? [];
      if (!list.includes(doc)) list.push(doc);
      codes.set(k, list);
      add(k, doc, W.code);
    }
    const nameWords = words(t.name);
    for (const w of nameWords) add(w, doc, W.name);
    // joined neighbours, so "VITAMIN B-12" also answers "b12" and "T 3" answers "t3"
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < nameWords.length; i++) add(nameWords[i]! + nameWords[i + 1]!, doc, W.name * 0.9);
    for (const w of words(t.department)) add(w, doc, W.dept);
    if (t.sampleType) for (const w of words(t.sampleType)) add(w, doc, W.sample);
    for (const p of t.parameters) if (p.name) for (const w of words(p.name)) add(w, doc, W.param);
  });

  const vocab = [...postings.keys()].sort();
  const grams = new Map<string, number[]>(); // trigram → vocab indexes
  vocab.forEach((word, i) => {
    if (word.length < 3) return;
    for (const g of new Set(trigrams(word))) {
      const list = grams.get(g) ?? [];
      list.push(i);
      grams.set(g, list);
    }
  });

  /** first vocab index ≥ prefix */
  const lowerBound = (prefix: string) => {
    let lo = 0;
    let hi = vocab.length;
    while (lo < hi) {
      const mid = (lo + hi) >>> 1;
      if (vocab[mid]! < prefix) lo = mid + 1;
      else hi = mid;
    }
    return lo;
  };

  const wordCache = new Map<string, Map<number, number>>();
  /** score per doc for one word: exact > prefix > typo */
  function matchWord(w: string, fuzzy: boolean): Map<number, number> {
    const key = `${fuzzy ? 1 : 0}${w}`;
    const cached = wordCache.get(key);
    if (cached) return cached;
    const scores = new Map<number, number>();
    const bump = (word: string, factor: number) => {
      for (const p of postings.get(word) ?? []) scores.set(p.doc, Math.max(scores.get(p.doc) ?? 0, p.weight * factor));
    };
    if (postings.has(w)) bump(w, 3);
    for (let i = lowerBound(w); i < vocab.length && vocab[i]!.startsWith(w); i++)
      if (vocab[i] !== w) bump(vocab[i]!, w.length >= 3 ? 2 : 1.2);
    if (scores.size === 0 && fuzzy && w.length >= 4) {
      const q = trigrams(w);
      const counts = new Map<number, number>();
      for (const g of new Set(q)) for (const vi of grams.get(g) ?? []) counts.set(vi, (counts.get(vi) ?? 0) + 1);
      for (const [vi, shared] of counts) {
        const word = vocab[vi]!;
        const dice = (2 * shared) / (q.length + trigrams(word).length);
        if (dice >= 0.5) bump(word, dice);
      }
    }
    if (wordCache.size > 5000) wordCache.clear();
    wordCache.set(key, scores);
    return scores;
  }

  /** docs matching every word of a phrase; score = mean word score */
  function matchPhrase(phrase: string[], fuzzy: boolean): Map<number, number> {
    const maps = phrase.map((w) => matchWord(w, fuzzy));
    maps.sort((a, b) => a.size - b.size);
    const out = new Map<number, number>();
    for (const [doc, s] of maps[0] ?? []) {
      let sum = s;
      let all = true;
      for (let i = 1; i < maps.length; i++) {
        const v = maps[i]!.get(doc);
        if (v === undefined) { all = false; break; }
        sum += v;
      }
      if (all) out.set(doc, sum / phrase.length);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** best score per doc over alternatives (synonym phrases slightly below the literal words) */
  function matchGroup(alternatives: string[][], fuzzy: boolean): Map<number, number> {
    const out = new Map<number, number>();
    alternatives.forEach((alt, i) => {
      for (const [doc, s] of matchPhrase(alt, fuzzy)) {
        const v = i === 0 ? s : s * 0.95;
        if (v > (out.get(doc) ?? 0)) out.set(doc, v);
      }
    });
    return out;
  }

  function search(query: string, options: SearchOptions = {}): SearchHit[] {
    const limit = options.limit ?? 20;
    const fuzzy = options.fuzzy ?? true;
    const raw = normalize(query);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const compact = raw.replace(/ /g, "");
    const rawWords = raw.split(" ");

    // a whole-query synonym ("vit d") makes one group; otherwise one group per word
    const whole = SYNONYMS[raw] ? raw : SYNONYMS[compact] ? compact : null;
    const groups: string[][][] = whole
      ? [[rawWords, ...synonymAlternatives(whole)]]
      : rawWords.map((w) => [[w], ...synonymAlternatives(w)]);
    const phrases = whole ? [raw, ...synonymAlternatives(whole).map((a) => a.join(" "))] : [raw];

    const total = new Map<number, number>();
    const hitCount = new Map<number, number>();
    for (const g of groups)
      for (const [doc, s] of matchGroup(g, fuzzy)) {
        total.set(doc, (total.get(doc) ?? 0) + s);
        hitCount.set(doc, (hitCount.get(doc) ?? 0) + 1);
      }
    for (const doc of codes.get(compact) ?? []) {
      total.set(doc, (total.get(doc) ?? 0) + 100);
      hitCount.set(doc, groups.length);
    }

    const hits: SearchHit[] = [];
    for (const [doc, s] of total) {
      const t = tests[doc]!;
      if (options.department && t.department !== options.department) continue;
      if (options.sampleType && t.sampleType !== options.sampleType) continue;
      let score = s * ((hitCount.get(doc) ?? 0) / groups.length) ** 2;
      const name = names[doc]!;
      let bonus = 0;
      for (const p of phrases) {
        const pc = p.replace(/ /g, "");
        if (name === p || compactNames[doc] === pc) bonus = Math.max(bonus, 50);
        else if (name.startsWith(p) || compactNames[doc]!.startsWith(pc)) bonus = Math.max(bonus, 20);
        else if (name.includes(p) || compactNames[doc]!.includes(pc)) bonus = Math.max(bonus, 8);
      }
      score += bonus - name.length / 200; // shorter, more specific names win ties
      hits.push({ test: t, score });
    }
    hits.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.test.name.localeCompare(b.test.name));
    return hits.slice(0, limit);
  }

  return { search, size: tests.length };
}
```

## File: src/types.ts

```ts
/** How a parameter's result is entered and its reference shown. */
export type ParameterType =
  | "numeric" // a number checked against male/female bounds
  | "text" // free text; reference is a narrative (referenceText)
  | "options" // pick from a list (e.g. Positive / Negative)
  | "image" // an uploaded image (e.g. electrophoresis)
  | "title"; // a heading row inside the report

/** One side of a reference interval. Usually numbers; text when the lab wrote e.g. "<0.5". */
export type Bound = number | string | null;

export interface Interval {
  low: Bound;
  high: Bound;
}

export interface Parameter {
  /** e.g. "Hemoglobin". null for untitled narrative rows. */
  name: string | null;
  /** Canonical unit, e.g. "g/dL", "IU/mL", "µmol/L". */
  unit: string | null;
  /** Canonical method, e.g. "CLIA", "Calculated", "Electrical Impedance". */
  method: string | null;
  type: ParameterType;
  /** Order in the printed report. */
  position: number | null;
  male: Interval | null;
  female: Interval | null;
  /** Allowed values when type is "options". */
  options: string[] | null;
  /** True when the value is derived from other parameters. */
  calculated: boolean;
  /** Formula as stored by the lab software (refers to parameters as pr_<id>). */
  formula: string | null;
  /** Same formula with parameter names, e.g. "(28.7*HBA1C)-46.7". */
  formulaText: string | null;
  /** Narrative reference (age bands, interpretation), HTML stripped. */
  referenceText: string | null;
}

export type Department =
  | "CLINICAL BIOCHEMISTRY"
  | "CLINICAL PATHOLOGY"
  | "CYTOPATHOLOGY"
  | "HEMATOLOGY"
  | "HISTOPATHOLOGY"
  | "IMMUNOLOGY"
  | "MICROBIOLOGY"
  | "MOLECULAR"
  | "SEROLOGY"
  | (string & {});

/** What an entry is. Ids are numbered per kind: tests first, then profiles, then packages. */
export type CatalogKind = "test" | "profile" | "package";

/** "MGPLT0001" (test), "MGPLP0001" (profile), "MGPLK0001" (package): prefix + kind letter + 4 digits. */
export type CatalogId = `MGPL${"T" | "P" | "K"}${string}`;

export interface LabTest {
  /** MGPL id, e.g. "MGPLT0001". Assigned once by `npm run ids`, never reused or renumbered. */
  id: CatalogId;
  kind: CatalogKind;
  /** The lab software's numeric id (catalog-kit 1.x `id`); null for entries added after the move to MGPL ids. */
  legacyId: number | null;
  name: string;
  code: string | null;
  shortCode: string | null;
  searchCode: string | null;
  /** Price in rupees. */
  mrp: number | null;
  department: Department;
  /** Primary sample, e.g. "SERUM", "EDTA", "URINE". */
  sampleType: string | null;
  secondarySampleTypes: string[] | null;
  parameterCount: number;
  parameters: Parameter[];
}

export interface Catalog {
  generatedAt: string;
  source: string;
  tests: LabTest[];
}

export type Sex = "male" | "female";
```
